Title: Absolutely Appalling Customer Service – Avoid PRO:DIRECT!⭐ 1/5 – Extremely disappointing experienceOne of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had with an online retailer.I placed an order worth £132.99 and requested cancellation on the very same day, before I received any dispatch notification.Despite my cancellation request, PRO:DIRECT proceeded with dispatch the following day.Their excuse? Apparently, customers only have 15 minutes to cancel an order. After that, they claim there is absolutely nothing they can do, even if the parcel has not yet been delivered.I contacted customer service multiple times, explained the situation, referenced my consumer rights under UK law and even had the matter escalated to management.The result? Absolutely no meaningful assistance.To make matters worse, I explained that I am currently suffering from a knee injury that significantly restricts my mobility. Their proposed solution was for me to physically collect the parcel and arrange its return myself.Only after further complaints did they acknowledge that the uncollected parcel would eventually be returned automatically.Meanwhile, my £132.99 remains tied up while I wait for their delivery and returns process to run its course.What makes this particularly frustrating is that I tried to prevent this entire situation by requesting cancellation on the day of purchase.Customer service repeatedly hid behind the same 15-minute policy instead of offering a practical solution. Management was no more helpful.A company can have internal procedures, but that does not excuse such a rigid and customer-unfriendly approach.The complete lack of flexibility, accountability and genuine willingness to help is astonishing.I have retained all correspondence and dispatch notifications documenting this experience.I would strongly advise potential customers to think twice before ordering from PRO:DIRECT. If anything goes wrong, don’t expect much understanding or assistance.Never again. Extremely poor customer service.
